test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is there provision that "the Governor of a State shall at the expiration of every fifth year, constitute a Finance Commission to review the financial position of the Panchayats and to make recommendations to him'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**243 I**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• State Finance Commission is established by the Governer after every five years to look into the financial conditions of Panchayats.
 
• Article 243 I of the constitution provides for the establishment of a State Finance Commission.
 
• In accordance with article 243 I, the governor of a state shall after every five years constitute a State Finance Commission to review the financial position of panchayats.
 
• The state legislature may provide for the composition of the commission.
 
• The State Finance Commission makes the following recommendation to the governor:
 
 
• Principles that govern the distribution of taxes, duties, etc. between state and panchayats.
 
• Principles that govern the determination of taxes etc. that may be assigned to panchayats.
 
• Grants-in-aid to panchayats from the consolidated fund of the state.
 
• **The governor places recommendations of commission along with the action taken report before the state legislature**​
